text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I gave it my all. All that's left is—to 
see whether my running can reach the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...You were amazing, <chrname>-san. And also—

text_block_list.name: Fan's Comment
text_block_list.text:
"AWESOOOOME!! That was seriously so much 
fun!!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...! This is... From everyone who was 
watching—

text_block_list.name: Fan's Comment
text_block_list.text:
"<chrname>-chan's run and Victoire Pisa-chan's run 
were both so truly inspiring!"

text_block_list.name: Watching Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally... I completely forgot 
all about the selections. The race was 
just so intense...!

text_block_list.name: Watching Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm seriously getting hyped for the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe... I wonder what kind 
of race the Japanese contenders will show 
us...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Transcending the boundaries between 
fans. Everyone's feelings are becoming 
one."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: This is just like—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: No. That's not... all it is. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Matches' have concluded. The announcement 
of Team Japan's members will be made 
shortly—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you truly fine with this? 
Declining to be the representative, that 
is."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"You have real talent. Above all— I know 
just how much heart and soul you've poured 
into the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Would you mind telling me the reason?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Because I felt that if it's her—if it's 
<chrname>-san, she'll surely create a "circle" that 
expands across the world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
During that race—the fans were wild with 
excitement over our running.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly a single "ring." However—it 
wasn't just the fans who were connected by 
that "ring."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I was the same way.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I ran with the desire to win. Fully 
determined to claim the representative 
spot, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, halfway through—I completely 
forgot. I was so captivated by her 
running. I only felt the pure joy of 
running and giving it my all in that 
duel.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Before I even realized it, I was connected 
to the "circle" created by her running.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I want to—entrust my dream to the 
potential I felt in that run."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
By dedicating everything I have to 
supporting <chrname>-san.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ………… I see. I understand.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Just... please. I'm entrusting you with 
such a huge dream. Please, with all your 
might— support <chrname> for me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And now—I will announce the names of the 
Umamusume selected as representatives. The 
first is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ……<chrname>！！

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Please. I ask you from the bottom of my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
With your running— please create a 
'circle' that expands across the world.
